FORMAL REVIEW: BLOCK exact StoryAtlas candidate 32f4c726424a6327393de26915d0e549ff308fe4 for cand-7HECF7FE80K0D2JNA3CVM22593.

I independently inspected the isolated candidate at /private/tmp/storyatlas-semantic-proxy-clone, verified parent d295f4c, tree 5a77af3, exact nine-path scope, and clean diff. Three acceptance failures remain.

F1 VISUAL COMPOSITION. The candidate explicitly permits one target to be Direct for one selected address and Proxy for another. But app/index.html lines 31-32, 39-40, and 46-47 assign the same CSS properties at equal specificity; the later direct rule wins. The proxy class and accessible label remain, but its promised non-colour cue disappears. Add an explicit composite presentation or independent channels, with a browser computed-style court for ancestor plus descendant multi-selection.

F2 TARGET CLOSURE. AppCompiler.scala lines 237-280 validates only the aggregate flattened vector as nonempty. A multi-mark placement with one missing target still succeeds, and a nonempty phantom name also succeeds. SvgDom.scala lines 31-59 walks existing elements but never rejects leftover interaction names. Validate every placement member against the actual per-face rendered target index, including uniqueness and semantic identity; add unknown-name, partial-missing, proxy-missing, and duplicate courts.

F3 CODEX CAPACITY. smoke.cjs lines 521-531 and 602-607 explicitly retain Codex OnMark while exercising Atlas ViaAncestor. The proxy DOM/ARIA assertions are Atlas-only. The pure helper test supplies synthetic strings and does not cross CodexCompiler, pagination, lowering, inject, or CSS. Add an admitted diagnostic flow or DOM harness that produces a real Codex ViaAncestor and proves proxy class/style, truthful label and ARIA, activation to visible ancestor, and direct restoration. Do not claim both-face browser evidence before that path exists.

The direct/proxy ADTs, truthful proxy ARIA state, OffProjection absence, and Intaglio boundary are otherwise sound. This review is read-only; no path was edited.
